Loupe's badge. A small label for the review status of a document.

```jsx
<Badge status="in-review">Example</Badge>
<Badge status="draft">Example</Badge>
<Badge status="approved">Example</Badge>
<Badge status="changes-requested">Example</Badge>
```

Variants: `in-review`, `draft`, `approved`, `changes-requested`.

Labels are sentence case and never end in a full stop. The component emits the real `lp-badge` classes of the app.
